This game is genuinely very good. But you're here for that hat, aren't you?

No need to feel guilty, here's what you should do:
[b]Step 1:[/b] Install Alien Swarm
[b]Step 2:[/b] Find and join a server with Play Online; there is a Valve server always active (and a few community ones too, at the time I'm writing this, which you can find with the Dedicated Server Browser)
[b]Step 3:[/b] If no-one is around to play, and you don't feel like inviting anyone, the Landing Bay mission (the same one you play in Offline Practice) allows you to play alone. Being alone in the server means you're the "party leader" and get to choose what mission to play, so choose Landing Bay
[b]Step 4:[/b] Set difficulty to Easy and choose a Tech character
[b]Step 5:[/b] Beat the mission by yourself in any way you can. I recommend simply running through the level as fast as possible, sealing doors and not getting swarmed while reloading. Bringing a sentry gun as a secondary weapon is a good idea too
[b]Step 6:[/b] Repeat step 5 if necessary. Remember, the achievement requires 2 successful games
[b]Step 7:[/b] Earn the achievement and rejoice
[b]Step 8 (optional):[/b] Realize this game is actually pretty good, lament the fact its servers are dead
[b]Step 9 (optional):[/b] Find out about Alien Swarm: Reactive Drop - It's Alien Swarm, but improved and not dead
[b]Step 10 (optional):[/b] Uninstall Alien Swarm
[b]Step 11 (optional):[/b] Install Alien Swarm: Reactive Drop
